text:
raj: Quick status check — cutting over eu-west-3 (customer-facing) tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Need final owners, KMS residency, routing policy, and any blocking infra changes. cc @sophia @amy

sophia: I'm owner for routing rules. Confirming we'll use `eu-west-3` zone and the new geo-route policy v2?

raj: yes v2. Amy do you own KMS integration for Private customers in that region?

amy: I can own the KMS work. ETA EOD today to upload keys to customer KMS. One ask: does Private deployment need HSM prod approvals? (cc @marco)

marco: For private we need signed attestation. I filed the ticket INF-4823. Pending legal sign-off. Could delay ~24-48h. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4823

sophia: On routing: need to add fallback to `eu-west-1` for capacity tier 1. I'll add rule, but router config needs canary window 15m. Can someone vet this for latency regression?

amy: I'll run perf test post-canary. Ping me once canary starts.

raj: Deploy bot — start canary tomorrow 08:00 UTC window 08:00-08:15. deploy-bot please post status.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: eu-west-3 -> roll 20% traffic over 15m. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.com/eu-west-3-cutover. Notifications to oncall.

sophia: Also FYI: need firewall rule to permit egress to kms-eu endpoint. Security change request: SEC-1290.

marco: Noted. I can correlate SEC-1290 with INF-4823 to speed legal review.

raj: Action items so far — (1) @sophia add fallback + canary config; (2) @amy upload KMS keys + run perf test; (3) @marco chase legal + open PR if needed; (4) @sophia + @amy add small smoke test set to the runbook.

amy: Will add `smoke/latency` prompt set to runbook and post PR: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/812

sophia: Adding router snippet now:

```
routes:
  - region: eu-west-3
    weight: 20
    fallback: eu-west-1
    canary_window: 900
```

raj: Thanks. Last Q — any unblockers for Dedicated customers with data residency requirements (KMS + audit logs)?

marco: Dedicated customers require syslog forwarding to customer SIEM. Need ops checklist item — I added it to INF-4823.

amy: Will ensure audit logs are retained 90d per contract.

raj: Great. If no objections I'll kick canary at 08:00 UTC. Reply "ack" if you've seen this.

sophia: ack :thumbsup:

amy: ack

marco: ack

raj: thanks everyone — I'll post a brief cutover note in #announcements before we start.
